name: Media Entity Soundcloud
project_description:
Soundcloud integration for the Media Entity module.

 Installation 
 
 Enable the media_entity and media_entity_soundcloud module. 
 Go to /admin/structure/media and click 'Add media bundle' to create a new bundle. 
 Under Type provider select Soundcloud. 
 Save the bundle. 
 
 Configuration 
 
 Go to the Manage display section for the media bundle. 
 For the source field selected, select Soundcloud embed under Format . 
 Click on the settings icon to configure the embedded player. 
 Save. 
 
 Player configuration 
 
 Type: Visual or Classic 
 Options: Autoplay, Hide related, Show comments, Show user, Show reposts. 
 Width and height 
 Back to top
